item.title: Chart Rewind: In 2021, BTS’ ‘Butter’ Made a Smooth Start Atop the Hot 100
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and explore the latest trends and chart-toppers. Today, we're talking about the K-pop sensation BTS and their rise to the top of the Billboard charts.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "It all started with their summer anthem 'Butter', which debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in June 2021. As BTS' RM explained, 'Butter' is an upbeat, fresh dance-pop track that's all about positive vibes and energy. And it was a game-changer, ruling the chart for 10 weeks and becoming the biggest song of the summer.
[Music transitions to a clip of "Butter"]
Host: "But 'Butter' was just the beginning. BTS went on to achieve an impressive feat, becoming the fastest group to reach four number one singles on the Hot 100 chart since the Jackson 5 in 1970. And they didn't stop there, adding three more number one hits to their list, including 'Permission to Dance' and 'My Universe' with Coldplay.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "In fact, BTS achieved six number one singles in just over a year, a record that hasn't been seen since The Beatles in the 1960s. And just recently, they dropped their new single 'Swim', which debuted at number one on the Hot 100 chart, while their album 'ARIRANG' topped the Billboard 200 chart.
[Music transitions to a clip of "Swim"]
Host: "As BTS looks to the future, they're reflecting on their journey so far. In a 2021 interview, Suga shared that despite their rapid success, he feels like there's still so much left for them to do. With their world tour underway and new music on the horizon, it's clear that BTS is just getting started.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast today. Join us next time as we explore more music trends and chart-toppers. And don't forget to follow us for the latest updates on your favorite artists and bands."
